LESSON: KUANDIKA 6.3.1 INSHA ZA KUBUNI METHALI

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.3: Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza maana ya insha za methali ili kuipambanua
2. kujadili vipengele vya insha ya methali
3. kuandika insha ya methali kwa kuzingatia vipengele vya uandishi husika

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza maana ya insha za methali ili kuipambanua
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza maana ya insha za methali ili kuipambanua. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kujadili vipengele vya insha ya methali
   In simple words: practise until you can kujadili vipengele vya insha ya methali. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kuandika insha ya methali kwa kuzingatia vipengele vya uandishi husika
   In simple words: practise until you can kuandika insha ya methali kwa kuzingatia vipengele vya uandishi husika. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali.
4. Show that you can: kueleza maana ya insha za methali ili kuipambanua

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza maana ya insha za methali ili kuipambanua
2. kujadili vipengele vya insha ya methali
3. kuandika insha ya methali kwa kuzingatia vipengele vya uandishi husika

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
